program.name: Teaser Builder
program.subject: Mat core
program.blurb: Long Pilates core sessions that build toward the full teaser.
program.about: Core work with a goal: the teaser. Chest lifts, straight-leg stretches, teaser preps and single-leg teasers build the pieces, then the full teaser and control balance test them. Two sessions alternate. Level II brings harder moves and Level III adds reps.
